claims.subject: shadrix_silverquill

evidence.quote: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven University, Shadrix Silverquill is loquacious yet calculated
In establishing Silverquill College, he aimed to train the future leaders of the plane.

claims.summary: Shadrix Silverquill, one of the five founding elder dragons, established Silverquill College.

claims.subject: augusta_sos

evidence.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

claims.summary: Augusta died in the Phyrexian Invasion, but her summoned spirit still serves as Lorehold's interim dean of order.
claims.limitation: Her bio sits under the page's Lorehold heading and names Lorehold students; the quoted sentence itself does not name the college.

claims.subject: phyrexians

evidence.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

claims.summary: Augusta died during the Phyrexian Invasion.
claims.limitation: The text says she died in the invasion, not who killed her.

claims.subject: nev

evidence.quote: Twin to Adrix, Nev and his sibling grew up on the Pinzari Isles.

claims.summary: Nev and Adrix are merfolk twins from the Pinzari Isles.

claims.subject: nev

evidence.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

claims.summary: Nev and Adrix became deans of Quandrix after the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham.

claims.subject: adrix

evidence.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

claims.summary: Adrix is co-dean of Quandrix with Nev.

claims.subject: moseo

evidence.quote: Moseo willingly stepped up to replace the deceased Valentin as the new dean of the vein.

claims.summary: Moseo replaced the deceased Valentin as Witherbloom's dean of the vein.
claims.limitation: 'Dean of the vein' is one of Witherbloom's two deanships; the college name is from the bio's section heading.

claims.subject: primo

evidence.quote: Primo is Zimone's trusty companion fractal.
taking his role as Zimone's friend and stalwart defender very seriously

claims.summary: Primo is Zimone's companion fractal, friend and defender.

claims.subject: zimone

evidence.quote: Zimone initially summoned Primo because she merely enjoyed his wolflike form

claims.summary: Zimone summoned Primo and, after Duskmourn, would not unsummon him.

claims.subject: ral_zarek

evidence.quote: Ral Zarek is a recently arrived guest lecturer at Silverquill.

claims.summary: Ral Zarek is a guest lecturer at Silverquill.
claims.limitation: He is faculty (guest lecturer), not a student.

claims.subject: killian_lu

evidence.quote: Killian Lu is a Silverquill graduate student, currently mentoring younger students at the Forum of Amity.

claims.summary: Killian Lu, a Silverquill graduate student, mentors younger students at the Forum of Amity.
claims.limitation: He mentors there; formal membership of the Forum is not stated.

claims.subject: tam

evidence.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
Jadzi, so focused as she was on the spell she was weaving, had never suspected Tam.

claims.summary: Tam pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic while Jadzi was trying to calm the archaic.
claims.limitation: Jadzi's fate after the fall is not resolved in this episode.

claims.subject: tam

evidence.quote: "What did you just do? She was trying to help us!" Lluwen shouted.
Tam bit her lip. She tried to meet their eyes but found that she could not. "I was made to do this."

claims.summary: Tam's friends, Lluwen among them, saw her act as a betrayal; Tam says she was made to do it.
claims.limitation: The episode frames it as betrayal of the group; Tam's motive and maker are not explained here.

claims.subject: lluwen

evidence.quote: And thirteen nights exploring Titan's Grave with Lluwen.

claims.summary: Before the betrayal, Tam and Lluwen were friends who explored Titan's Grave together.

claims.subject: strixhaven_founder_dragons

evidence.quote: Founded over 700 years ago by five spellcasting dragons, Strixhaven University is Arcavios's premier institution of magical learning

claims.summary: Five spellcasting dragons founded Strixhaven University over 700 years ago.

claims.subject: shadrix_silverquill

evidence.quote: Located in the northeast region of Arcavios, the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

claims.summary: Shadrix Silverquill founded the Forum of Amity in northeast Arcavios as a centre for diplomacy.

claims.subject: dawning_archaic

evidence.quote: The Dawning Archaic was formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever oracle on the plane.
When an oracle dies, their mind and spirit are swept off into the distant past, drawn backward through time toward the intense magical power of the Dawning Age.

claims.summary: Archaics are born in the Dawning Age from the souls of oracles; the Dawning Archaic comes from the last-ever oracle of Arcavios.
claims.limitation: That oracle lies in the plane's future; the pages do not name them.
